member.name: M:Ranks.Contract.RanksModuleBase.OnPointsChanging(Ranks.Contract.RanksPointsChangingArgs)
member.remarks: Subscriber order across modules is undefined and each sees the previous one's Amount, so two modules scaling one award compose in an order nobody chose. Do not score here — call AddPoints with your own number.

member.remarks: The guard is what the handshake makes necessary: it re-runs on every plugin load and unload, so an unguarded += is one duplicate subscription per rebuild.

member.name: M:Ranks.Contract.RanksModuleBase.Unregister

member.name: M:Ranks.Contract.RanksModuleBase.RaiseCoreReady
